question: Congratulations on Bonds of Ice and season two! It's all wonderful news and I'm looking forward to it! If someone used a sense-sharing spell like Nect on Otto, would they receive the Blessing of the Spirit of Words as well?
answer: It's possible, but if Otto isn't adjusting the sensations, it would probably drive them insane. With a properly-developed self-awareness, being hit with an uncontrolled "Blessing of the Spirit of Words" would do that to pretty much anyone. Otto was alright because he hadn't developed enough of a sense of self to be driven insane.
